messages:
Sam: kicking off handoff — short summary of the late-night routing spill in eu-west — routing rule for model-shard A accidentally promoted to global, caused cross-region spill to us-west and transient 503s for some eu customers. will summarize what we did + next steps.

incident-bot: ALERT TRIGGERED • 2026-07-03T02:14:05Z 
- Pager: routing-propagation-anomaly
- Sev: P2
- Symptoms: 503s and increased p95 latency for model-shard A in eu-west; sudden uptick in cross-region egress and pod saturation in us-west.

Priya: timeline quick notes (grab for the handoff):
- 02:14 — first alert: spike in 503s, routing mismatch detected in control plane logs
- 02:20 — on-call triage: verified traffic graphs, saw region tag flip to global for model-shard A
- 02:26 — disabled new routing rule via control-plane API (command below) to stop further propagation
- 02:32 — applied temporary regional override to force eu-west local-serving for shard A
- 02:40 — observed traffic returning to eu-west nodes, 503 rate reduced to baseline by ~02:50

Tess: root cause summary — release pipeline promoted a routing feature-flag change without validating region-scoped constraint. Canary gating missed the manifest because of a flaky approval webhook. Essentially a policy-level regression: a flag that was meant to be scoped to eu-west got rolled out as global.

Jordan: logs that show the propagation (sanitized):
```
I0703 02:18:09.567 controlplane.go:289] promoted routing rule "shard-A-region-scope": promoted -> global
W0703 02:18:12.992 router.go:112] mismatch: expected region=eu-west but effective=global, applying fallback
E0703 02:20:01.123 proxy.go:410] 503 serving request: upstream capacity exhausted
```

Sam: commands and quick ops runbook steps we executed:
```
# revoke the accidental promotion
redctl routing revoke --rule shard-A-region-scope --reason "rollback accidental global promotion"
# apply regional override to prevent cross-region mapping
redctl routing set-override --region eu-west --shard shard-A --force-local
# validate with a dry-run on the control-plane operator
kubectl -n control-plane exec deploy/routing-operator -- /bin/routingctl validate --shard=shard-A --scope=region
```

Priya: customer impact — scoped and assessed:
- Affected: a small cohort of customers with heavy model-shard-A traffic originating from eu-west during the 02:18–02:50 window.
- Impact: elevated 503s and some requeues; user-facing API call retries masked some failures. No SLO breach detected yet but support needs to reach out.
- Support ticket created: INC-2026-3487 (linked to customer list).

Tess: immediate mitigations and config changes we made
- revoked the promotion and applied regional override (see commands)
- temporarily increased us-west capacity to avoid collateral degradation while rollback completed
- added an alert for control-plane promotions without webhook approval flagged

Jordan: ownership and handoff responsibilities
- Sam (primary tonight) remains available for technical follow-up until 10:00 UTC
- Priya will own customer comms and will open the support thread in #support-now and attach the ticket (INC-2026-3487)
- Tess will drive the postmortem and coordinate with release infra to add gating for region-scope flags

Sam: outstanding action items (short actionable list)
- [ ] Tess: produce a short RCA draft and include the missing webhook approval trace (ETA: 24h)
- [ ] Release infra: add a pre-promotion manifest check and a webhook retry/backoff fix (ETA: 72h)
- [ ] Support (Priya): run customer outreach using the template in the runbook and link the incident ticket (ETA: 3h)
- [ ] Ops: revert us-west capacity temporary boost once global metrics stable for 60m (Sam to coordinate)

Priya: runbook & references
- Routing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-promotions
- Promotion gating doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/promotion-gating
- Support template: https://redwood.internal/support/templates/early-outage-notice

Tess: coverage note for next shift (please read):
- Primary tonight: Sam (on-call until 10:00 UTC)
- Secondary: Priya
- Backup escalation: Jordan (release infra)
- Known gap: no control-plane engineer on-call between 04:00–06:00 UTC; if control-plane promos appear, escalate to release infra Slack + page Jordan directly.

Sam: quick risk mitigation doc snippet to add to the runbook (paste into the page when convenient):
"If a region-scoped routing flag is promoted globally, immediately revoke the promotion, apply a region override to force local-serving, and block further promotions until the gating webhook has confirmed approvals. Add a short-term alert: 'routing-promotion-unapproved' that pages release infra. Consider a temporary global block during high-traffic windows.
"

Priya: final notes before handoff
- No customer-facing public status update yet; support will prepare a targeted outreach for the affected customers only.
- We'll keep the incident open for tracking until the postmortem lands and the gating fix is merged.

incident-bot: Incident marked resolved (automation) • 2026-07-03T03:50:12Z

Sam: handing off to overnight — ping me if anything reappears, I'll be reachable on pager for 1h. Good handoff. :thumbsup:

--- end of thread ---
